mainEntity.name: How long does a main water shutoff valve repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a main water shutoff valve repair can vary based on the valve's condition, accessibility, and type. A straightforward repair might take 1-2 hours, while a full replacement could extend to 3-4 hours, especially if pipes need modification. We prioritize efficient service to minimize disruption to your home in locations like Summerlin.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from 1-2 hours for simple fixes to 3-4 hours for replacements, depending on complexity.
